headline: SIX VERY DIFFERENT REASONS TO EXPLORE
dek: Dunes, wildlife and the Atlantic coast
caption:
Namibia is the sort of road trip you start plotting in a group chat. 🌍

Picture a day among Spitzkoppe's granite arches, an early-morning dune climb around Sossusvlei, and the surreal walk across Deadvlei's pale clay pan.

Then switch up the adventure entirely: try sandboarding near Swakopmund, take a self-drive safari through Etosha's waterhole country, and join a guided kayaking trip on the Walvis Bay coast.

Six very different experiences — and they're spread across big distances, so build a longer itinerary rather than rushing between them. Wildlife sightings depend on the conditions and luck; park rules and road access should be checked before travelling.

Which two would you put first on your road trip? Send it to your travel crew. 🗺️

Photos: NIR HIMI, Andrew Svk, David Lartey & Patrick Duvanel / Unsplash.
